policy_change: Restore strict exclude_if_model_total_parameters >=250,000,000,000, applied to all model architectures including MoE total count. Existing inference RAM/space screens remain in force. Do not infer fit or permission.
source: User explicitly corrected mistaken removal of the original >=250B cutoff on 2026-11-03.
parameter_units: number of parameters (dimensionless; B means 10^9, not 1 byte)
applies_to: quantized / converted model aliases of same original architecture

mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B.source_quote_context: 52B active and 1.05T total parameters. Separate 1.6B vision encoder is also noted.

replacement_operations.rationale: User-restored hard cutoff: any model with total parameters >=250B, including inactive MoE experts, is excluded. Publisher reports Mistral Large 4 ~1.05T total and 52B active; the 52B active figure does not exempt it.
